content: We got a list of templates. Need the one that when applied to target yields the precursors list. The list includes reaction_id 182479 etc. We need to find which template matches our transformation. The precursors involve silyl chloride (Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C) which is t-butyldimethylsilyl chloride? Actually Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C is t-butyldimethylsilyl chloride (TBDMSCl). The reaction likely is silylation of an alcohol with TBDMSCl, forming O-Si bond and releasing Cl- (maybe with base). So the template is protection of alcohol with silyl chloride. The template should have functional_groups_broken: maybe "hydroxyl" broken? Actually O-H bond broken, Si-Cl bond broken, forming Si-O bond. The functional groups formed: "trimethylsilyl"? Actually silyl ether formed. The functional groups broken: "aliphatic hydroxyls". Formed: "trimethylsilyl". Let's search with broken aliphatic hydroxyls and formed trimethylsilyl.
